Product Id: Required if no SKU (found in Manage Products > Export to CSV)
Ordered Qty: Required for simple or composite products
Unit: Optional; the transfer unit (e.g. ctn) for products tracked in multiple units. Leave blank to transfer in the base unit.
Serial Numbers: Required for serialized products only; Must be unique if specified; Use semicolon(;) to separate multiple serial numbers. Serial numbers containing semicolons cannot be included in the CSV. Please enter them individually in the Stock Transfer page.
